note: Mr. Beast's document had one item that talked about cultivating your information diet. I thought that was an interesting way to express it. There's a lot of connections that can be made by exposing yourself to a variety of information sources or other media. I remember hearing an interview with a musician talking about 'training your ear' and getting exposed to lots of different music types to be a better musician. The amount of art, programming, math and other technical resources help me make connections that would be harder if my scope were more limited.
